# ADV Digital Marketing

> ADV Digital Marketing is a boutique performance marketing agency in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, founded by Alvin Yap in 2025 (SSM 202603036290). It builds and operates full marketing infrastructure for B2B and SME clients — Meta (Facebook & Instagram) advertising, Google Ads, SEO with Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO), and AI-powered marketing automation using Claude, Make.com, and Notion.

Key facts:
- Founded and led by Alvin Yap, based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
- Serves Malaysian SMEs and regional brands across B2B services, e-commerce, F&B, healthcare, and professional services
- Offers AEO (optimisation for ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini citations) and GEO (optimisation for Google AI Overviews)
- Builds AI automation systems: AI content brief generation, automated reporting, CRM workflows
